title: Textiles Machinery and Accessories - Cylindrical Sliver Cans, Part 3: Spring Bottoms
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 93 specifies the principal features of spring bottoms, with and without pre-tension, used in cylindrical sliver cans specified in ISO 93-1.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Textiles Machinery and Accessories - Cylindrical Sliver Cans, Part 2: Main Dimensions

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
